Delight in delicious options for your special Thanksgiving holiday meal.

We have sumptuous dishes available at Crown & Anchor from our herb-butter roasted turkey and decadent warm apple tart for dessert. Enjoy a complete two or three-course meal or choose from á la carte to satisfy your turkey cravings – so much to be thankful for.
